title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf Faces Funding End
items.text: Carlos Ortiz said LIV Golf’s future is tough as Saudi funding ends after 2026, calling it "a shame" but pledging to find a place to play.

items.headline: 2028 PGA Tour Two-Tier System
items.text: The PGA Tour will launch a two-tier system in 2028 focusing on developmental pathways, with courses like Bermuda and Colonial fighting to avoid lower-tier status.

items.headline: YouTuber Brad Dalke Contends
items.text: Brad Dalke shot a second-round 66 at the BMW International Open, tying for third and just one shot behind co-leaders Hollick and Ortiz at 10-under.
